prompt_cn: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on how short videos affect college life. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
prompt_en: Write an essay on how short videos affect college students, covering both sides and your own view (120-180 words).

paragraphs.en: Walk into any campus canteen at lunchtime and you will see students laughing at fifteen-second clips on their phones. Short videos have quietly become the default way for many undergraduates to fill spare minutes, yet opinion is divided over whether this habit enriches campus life or steals it. My own answer is that it depends on who is holding the phone.
paragraphs.cn: 中午走进任何一间校园食堂，你都会看到学生们对着手机里十几秒的视频发笑。短视频已经悄然成为许多本科生打发零碎时间的默认方式，但对于它究竟是丰富了校园生活还是偷走了校园生活，人们的看法并不一致。我的回答是：这取决于手机握在谁手里。
paragraphs.role: 开头段：场景引入 + 争议焦点 + 亮明观点

paragraphs.en: Used well, these clips are a cheap and flexible classroom. A student can learn to fold a paper crane, follow a three-minute explanation of compound interest, or hear how a difficult word is really pronounced, all without paying a penny. For those far from big cities, such open resources narrow the gap with better-funded peers.
paragraphs.cn: 用得恰当，这些短片就是一间廉价而灵活的课堂。学生可以学着折一只纸鹤，听三分钟讲清复利，或者听清一个难词究竟怎么读，而这一切都不用花一分钱。对于远离大城市的学生来说，这些开放资源缩小了他们与经费更充足的同龄人之间的差距。
paragraphs.role: 主体段：论证短视频的益处（低成本学习 + 教育公平）

paragraphs.en: The trouble is that the same apps are built to keep us scrolling. One clip leads to another, and a ten-minute break quietly swallows an evening that should have gone to reading or sleep. My view is simple: short videos are a tool, not a habit. Set a timer, choose topics on purpose, and put the phone away.
paragraphs.cn: 问题在于，同一批应用本就为让人一直刷下去而设计。一条短片牵出下一条，原本十分钟的休息悄悄吞掉了本该用来读书或睡觉的整个晚上。我的看法很简单：短视频是工具，不是习惯。设个计时器，有目的地挑选内容，然后放下手机。
paragraphs.role: 结尾段：指出弊端 + 重申观点 + 给出可操作建议

points: 以食堂里的真实场景切入
提出观点取决于使用方式
举例：手工、复利科普、发音
落到教育资源薄弱地区的学生
揭示算法设计的成瘾性
给出设闹钟、有目的筛选等建议

highlights.text: have quietly become the default way
highlights.note: quietly 暗示变化是不知不觉的；default way 指默认选择，比 common way 更精确。

highlights.text: opinion is divided over whether
highlights.note: 一句话引出争议，比 people have different opinions 更凝练，适合利弊类开头。

highlights.text: narrow the gap with better-funded peers
highlights.note: narrow the gap 缩小差距；better-funded 是复合形容词，指经费更充足的同类群体。

highlights.text: are built to keep us scrolling
highlights.note: be built to do 点明设计意图，把问题归于机制而非意志力，语气克制有力。

highlights.text: a tool, not a habit
highlights.note: 对照短句收束观点，节奏干净，可直接用于利弊类作文结尾。

tips: 开头用一个具体场景代替 Nowadays 式泛泛而谈
利与弊各占一段，个人观点留到结尾单独落定
每段只讲一个中心，段首用主题句统领
结尾给可操作的建议，比空喊口号更得分

title_en: Shared Bikes on the Rise in Our City
title_cn: 我市共享单车使用量持续增长
prompt_cn: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on a chart of shared bikes in a city. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
prompt_en: Describe the three-year trend in shared bike use shown in the chart, explain the causes and give a brief outlook (120-180 words).

paragraphs.en: The chart shows how many trips city residents made by shared bike over the past three years. In 2021 the number stood at 12 million rides; it climbed to 19 million in 2022 and reached 27 million last year, which means the figure more than doubled in two years. The climb is steady rather than sudden.
paragraphs.cn: 图表显示了过去三年本市居民骑共享单车出行的次数。2021 年这一数字为 1200 万次，2022 年攀升至 1900 万次，去年达到 2700 万次，也就是说两年间翻了一倍还多。增长是稳步的，而非突变。
paragraphs.role: 第一段：总述图表 + 分列三年数据 + 概括趋势特征

paragraphs.en: Three forces explain the growth. The city added over 200 kilometres of protected cycle lanes, so riders no longer share the road with heavy trucks. Fares stayed low while bus journeys slowed down during months of road repairs. Above all, phone unlocking made renting a bike a ten-second job, and students soon treated the blue bicycles outside their dormitories as their own.
paragraphs.cn: 有三股力量可以解释这一增长。城市新增了 200 多公里的隔离自行车道，骑行者不必再与重型卡车抢道。票价保持低廉，而公交出行在数月道路施工期间变得缓慢。更重要的是，手机扫码开锁让租车成了十秒钟的事，学生们很快就把宿舍楼下的蓝色单车当成了自己的车。
paragraphs.role: 第二段：分层分析增长原因（设施、价格、技术门槛）

paragraphs.en: Will the trend continue? Growth should slow but not reverse. Planners are already capping the number of bikes in crowded districts to keep pavements clear, and electric models may attract older riders who avoid hills. As long as repairs keep pace with demand, shared bikes will stay a normal part of daily travel here.
paragraphs.cn: 这一趋势会延续吗？增长应当放缓，但不会逆转。规划部门已在人流密集的区域限制单车投放数量，以保持人行道通畅；电动车型则可能吸引那些不愿爬坡的年长骑行者。只要维修能跟得上需求，共享单车仍将是本市日常出行中寻常的一部分。
paragraphs.role: 第三段：趋势展望（放缓不逆转）+ 条件句收束

points: 概括为稳步增长而非骤增
票价低与公交变慢的对比
扫码开锁降低使用门槛
判断增速放缓但不逆转
用 as long as 条件句收尾

highlights.text: the number stood at 12 million rides
highlights.note: stand at 用于描述某一时点的数值，图表首句常用，比 was 更正式。

highlights.text: more than doubled in two years
highlights.note: double 作动词表翻倍，more than 修饰幅度，一句概括两年变化。

highlights.text: steady rather than sudden
highlights.note: rather than 前后对照，给趋势定性，避免只罗列数字。

highlights.text: Three forces explain the growth.
highlights.note: 简短主题句，用 forces 替换 reasons，衔接自然且不重复。

highlights.text: As long as repairs keep pace with demand
highlights.note: as long as 引导条件状语从句；keep pace with 表示与……同步。

tips: 先总述再分述，数据只挑三四个关键值
描述走势换用 climb / double / slow / reverse，避免反复用 increase
原因按设施、价格、技术分层，一层一句
展望段用 should / may / as long as 留出分寸感

prompt_cn: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a notice about an English speech contest. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
prompt_en: Write a notice in the name of the Student Union announcing an English speech contest (120-180 words).

paragraphs.en:
NOTICE

Dear fellow students,

The Student Union will hold an English Speech Contest on Saturday, 18 May, in the lecture hall of the library. The contest starts at two in the afternoon and will last about three hours. This year's theme is "My Campus, My Future", and each speaker will talk for four to five minutes.
paragraphs.cn:
通知

各位同学：

学生会将于 5 月 18 日（星期六）在图书馆报告厅举办英语演讲比赛。比赛下午两点开始，持续约三个小时。今年的主题是“我的校园，我的未来”，每位选手演讲四到五分钟。
paragraphs.role: 标题 + 称呼 + 活动时间地点与主题

paragraphs.en: If you wish to take part, please send your name, class and a short outline of your speech to studentunion@campus.edu before 10 May. Late entries cannot be accepted. Contestants must write their own scripts, speak without reading from paper, and keep to the time limit. Two teachers will judge accuracy, fluency and stage presence.
paragraphs.cn: 有意参加者请于 5 月 10 日前将姓名、班级和一份简短的演讲提纲发送至 studentunion@campus.edu。逾期报名不予受理。参赛者必须自己撰写讲稿、脱稿演讲并遵守时间限制。两位老师将从语言准确度、流利度和舞台表现三方面评分。
paragraphs.role: 报名方式与截止时间 + 参赛要求 + 评分维度

paragraphs.en:
The top three speakers will receive books and certificates, and every contestant will get a small gift. The contest is a friendly chance to practise speaking in front of a real audience, so do not worry about making mistakes. We look forward to hearing your voice.

The Student Union

8 May
paragraphs.cn:
前三名选手将获得图书和证书，每位参赛者也会得到一份小礼品。比赛是一次在真实观众面前练习口语的友好机会，所以不必担心出错。期待听到你的声音。

学生会

5 月 8 日
paragraphs.role: 结尾：奖励与鼓励 + 落款与日期

points: 原创、脱稿、限时三项要求

highlights.text: The Student Union will hold an English Speech Contest
highlights.note: 通知主体句：主办方 + will hold + 活动名，一句话交代核心信息。

highlights.text: starts at two in the afternoon
highlights.note: 具体到钟点，通知中的时间要写实，不能只写 in the afternoon。

highlights.text: Late entries cannot be accepted.
highlights.note: 被动短句强调规定，比主动句更正式，是通知的常用语气。

highlights.text: speak without reading from paper
highlights.note: 以 without doing 表达脱稿要求，简洁且不易写成中式表达。

highlights.text: We look forward to hearing your voice.
highlights.note: look forward to doing 结尾，既收束全文又带鼓励意味。

tips: 通知四要素齐全：标题、称呼、正文、落款，缺一即扣分
时间地点写具体，避免 soon、somewhere 这类模糊词
要求用 must / cannot 等情态动词，语气正式明确
结尾加一句鼓励语，比只列完要求更有人情味

title_en: Making the Most of Four College Years
prompt_cn: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a speech welcoming freshmen on college life. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
prompt_en: Write a welcome speech for freshmen offering your advice on how to spend four college years (120-180 words).

paragraphs.en:
Good morning, dear freshmen and teachers,

It is a great honour to speak for the senior students on this first day of your university life. Four years ago I sat exactly where you are sitting now, excited and a little lost. Looking back, I would like to share three lessons that have shaped my time here.
paragraphs.cn:
各位新同学、各位老师，早上好：

很荣幸在你们大学生活的第一天代表高年级同学发言。四年前，我就坐在你们此刻坐着的位置上，既兴奋又有些茫然。回望这几年，我想分享三条塑造了我大学时光的经验。
paragraphs.role: 称呼 + 开场：身份、场合共鸣 + 预告三条建议

paragraphs.en: First, explore before you specialise. Try a course outside your major, join one club that scares you a little, and talk to teachers after class; a narrow path chosen too early is hard to widen. Second, protect your mornings. The library at eight is quiet, and two focused hours there are worth an afternoon of scattered effort.
paragraphs.cn: 第一，先探索，再专精。去选一门本专业以外的课，加入一个让你有点怯的社团，课后找老师聊聊天；过早选定的窄路很难再拓宽。第二，守住你的早晨。八点的图书馆很安静，在那里专注两小时，抵得上一整个下午的零散忙碌。
paragraphs.role: 主体段：建议一（先探索后专精）+ 建议二（守住高效时段）

paragraphs.en: Finally, be kind to yourself and to others. Nobody's four years look as smooth as the photos suggest, and asking for help is a skill rather than a weakness. May your years here be full of honest effort, real friends and good company. Thank you for listening, and welcome to this big family.
paragraphs.cn: 最后，对自己和他人友善一些。没有人的四年像照片里那样顺遂，求助是一种能力，而不是软弱。愿你们在这里的岁月里，有踏实的努力、真诚的朋友和值得相伴的人。谢谢大家的聆听，欢迎加入这个大家庭。
paragraphs.role: 结尾：建议三（善待自己与他人）+ 祝福 + 致谢收束

points: 四年前的同一处座位引发共鸣
建议二：守住早晨的专注时间
建议三：善待自己与他人

highlights.text: It is a great honour to speak for the senior students
highlights.note: It is a great honour to do 是演讲开场的得体句式，比 I am happy to 更正式。

highlights.text: excited and a little lost
highlights.note: 两个形容词并列作伴随状态，写出新生的真实心境，拉近距离。

highlights.text: explore before you specialise
highlights.note: 祈使句 + before 从句，建议短促有力，适合演讲节奏。

highlights.text: are worth an afternoon of scattered effort
highlights.note: be worth + 名词，用对比突出专注的价值，比 is important 具体。

highlights.text: asking for help is a skill rather than a weakness
highlights.note: 动名词作主语，rather than 扭转常见偏见，观点鲜明。

tips: 开场点明身份与场合，用共同经历与新听众建立联系
三条建议用 first / second / finally 分层，每条补一个细节
多用 you 与 we，少用 I，符合演讲语体
结尾先致谢再祝福，控制在 160 词左右便于朗读
